price_note: Prices tax-included, transcribed from the shop's own Soba / A la Carte / Course pages (site notice: menu last revised 2026-06-26) and cross-checked item by item against its own PDF allergen chart. Prices approximate — may change. A ¥550 otoshi (table charge) applies.

items.en: Chilled soba on a slatted box with dipping tsuyu — the shop's calling card. Choose 更科 (sarashina, pale inner flour) or 十割 (juwari, 100% buckwheat)
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 店の公式アレルゲン表で小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」、つゆは特製グルテンフリー辛汁。Shop's own allergen chart marks both 小麦 (wheat) and 大麦 (barley) 該当なし, and unusually for Japan the dipping tsuyu is a purpose-made gluten-free one — so here even the 十割 really is safe, unlike almost every other soba shop. Tsuyu contains fish (魚介), so not vegan.

items.en: Cold soba with a hot dipping broth built on chopped duck and scorched spring onion
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし。Allergen chart clears wheat and barley; the tsuyu is the house gluten-free one. Duck and fish stock.

items.ja: 米粉の天せいろうそば
items.en: Cold soba with prawn and seasonal-vegetable tempura fried in rice-flour batter
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 天麩羅粉は米粉。アレルゲン表は海老・卵を表示するが小麦は「該当なし」。The tempura flour is rice-based — the chart flags prawn and egg in it, not wheat. Gluten-free tempura barely exists in Tokyo; this is it.

items.en: Cold soba with grated yamato-imo yam blended with iron-rich beetroot and enriched with egg yolk
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし、卵あり。Chart clears wheat and barley; contains egg.

items.en: Hot soba in the Edo-style sweet broth (甘汁)
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 甘汁もグルテンフリー仕様、アレルゲン表で小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The hot 甘汁 broth is also made wheat-free per the shop; bonito/fish stock so not vegan.

items.en: Hot soba with rice-flour prawn tempura
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 米粉衣。アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦 該当なし。Rice-flour batter; chart flags prawn, egg and fish but not wheat.

items.en: Hot soba with duck fat and Japanese parsley (seri) in the sweet broth
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし、鴨・魚介あり。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.en: Cold soba with sukiyaki-style simmered wagyu sirloin and plenty of egg yolk
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: すき焼き風の割下も店のグルテンフリー醤油仕様、アレルゲン表で小麦 該当なし。The sukiyaki-style braising liquid uses the house gluten-free soy — the chart shows no wheat. Contains egg and beef.

items.en: Cold soba tangled with raw sea urchin and egg yolk, with crunchy tenkasu
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: 天かすは蕎麦粉と米粉製。アレルゲン表：小麦 該当なし、卵・魚介あり。The tenkasu here is made from buckwheat and rice flour, not wheat — that is why it clears the chart.

items.en: The richest bowl on the card: creamy chicken paitan deepened with niboshi sardine, topped with pork, duck and chicken chashu
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（煮卵）・魚介（蒲鉾）・豚・鶏・鴨あり、小麦・大麦 該当なし。Chart flags egg, fish cake and three meats but no wheat or barley — a chashu-topped bowl that is still gluten-free is close to unheard of.

items.en: Bone-broth soba sharpened with salted ginger, the garnishes laid out as the face of Okame the folk mask
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（煮卵）・魚介（蒲鉾）・豚あり、小麦・大麦 該当なし。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.ja: そばの追加（大盛り／追加つゆ／追加薬味／追加せいろう／ろく助の塩）
items.en: Soba add-ons: large portion +¥330 · extra tsuyu +¥385 · extra condiments +¥220 · extra soba box +¥660 · Rokusuke salt +¥150
items.section: おそば 追加 Soba add-ons
items.note: つゆ・蕎麦とも店のグルテンフリー仕様（アレルゲン表）。Both the noodle and the tsuyu are the shop's gluten-free versions per its own allergen chart.

items.en: Buckwheat 'dumpling' — soba flour and whole groats kneaded together and oven-roasted. The opener every course starts with
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。The allergen chart shows all fourteen listed allergens 該当なし for this dish — the cleanest thing on the card. Price not published separately (it comes as the otoshi).

items.en: Five-piece assortment of the house drinking snacks — order it while you wait for the soba. Two portions minimum
items.note: 警告：アレルゲン表で大麦（山ウニ）と胡桃（味噌ナッツ）が「入っている」。WARNING — the shop's own chart flags 大麦 (barley) in this platter, via the 山ウニ condiment, plus walnut. Barley is gluten. This is the one sobamae dish here a coeliac must refuse, and it is also the platter built into all three courses.

items.en: A slab of thick fried tofu from Fukuoka's celebrated Mihara Tofu, oven-crisped; eaten plain with ginger-soy or with toppings you choose
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。生姜醤油は店のグルテンフリー醤油を指定のこと。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし. It is served with ginger-soy — ask for the house gluten-free soy. Vegan only if you skip bonito-type toppings — ask.

items.en: Large-bean natto dressed in the house mentsuyu, finished with shiso leaf
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」、自家製めんつゆはグルテンフリー。Chart clears everything, and the house mentsuyu is the gluten-free one — ordinary natto sauce is soy-and-wheat, so this is a real distinction. Mentsuyu is dashi-based; ask about bonito for vegan.

items.en: Grilled Edomae nori from Funabashi Sanbanze, with real wasabi
items.note: 店が「お好みでグルテンフリーの醤油で」と明記。アレルゲン表は海苔の海老・蟹コンタミのみ、小麦・大麦なし。Shop explicitly offers its gluten-free soy with it; the only chart flag is a shrimp/crab cross-contact note on the nori itself. Plant-only.

items.en: Sliced kamaboko fish cake sent direct from Miyoshi Kamaboko in Yamaguchi — 100% domestic lizardfish — with wasabi
items.note: 店の表記「国産鮮魚エソ100%のグルテンフリーな蒲鉾」、アレルゲン表も小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The shop's own wording is 'gluten-free kamaboko'. Most kamaboko is bound with wheat starch, so this is a deliberate choice, and the chart backs it. Fish.

items.en: House paste of Ishino Saikyo miso and toasted buckwheat groats with nuts — built for sake
items.note: アレルゲン表：胡桃・蕎麦あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」（西京味噌＝米味噌で麦味噌ではない）。Chart flags walnut and buckwheat but clears wheat and barley — Saikyo miso is a rice miso, not the barley 麦味噌 that would carry gluten. Walnut allergy warning.

items.ja: 酔っ払い鴨とあんぽ柿
items.en: Duck simmered slowly in rum, served against the dense sweetness of semi-dried anpo persimmon
items.note: アレルゲン表：鴨のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags only duck. Rum, not a malt spirit.

items.ja: 尾崎牛もも肉炙りユッケ
items.en: Seared Ozaki-beef round, chopped tartare-style; mix in the thick egg yolk and eat with the house foamed soy
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーの泡醤油」と明記、アレルゲン表も小麦「該当なし」。The shop names its 泡醤油 as gluten-free and the chart agrees. Egg and beef.

items.en: Selected bluefin tuna in a fragrant garlic-chive soy
items.note: アレルゲン表（やま幸 鮪 ニラ醤油）：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart lists fish only; the nira-shoyu is made with the house gluten-free soy.

items.en: The day's recommended fish as sashimi, with the house gluten-free ponzu and mustard
items.note: 自家製ポン酢はグルテンフリー（店の記載）、アレルゲン表：魚介のみ。The house ponzu is stated gluten-free; chart flags fish only. Price varies with the market — ask.

items.ja: 飛騨ジャンボなめことわさび芋
items.en: Fat Hida nameko mushrooms with fresh grated nagaimo yam and the house mentsuyu
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーのめんつゆ」と明記、アレルゲン表は海苔のコンタミのみ。Shop names the mentsuyu as gluten-free; only a nori cross-contact flag on the chart. Mentsuyu is dashi — ask for vegan.

items.en: Rich Nikko yuba tofu under crisp 'tanuki' crumbs made from nori, buckwheat and rice flour, with mentsuyu
items.note: 天かすは蕎麦粉・米粉製。アレルゲン表：卵あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The crunchy bits are buckwheat and rice, not the wheat tenkasu this dish normally uses. Chart flags egg.

items.en: Shishito peppers deep-fried whole and dusted with grape shichimi
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。フライヤーは米粉のみの店。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし, and this kitchen's fryer only ever handles rice-flour batter — the shared-fryer problem that rules out fried food elsewhere does not apply.

items.ja: 和牛すじ肉と茄子の旨煮
items.romaji: wagyu suji to nasu no umani
items.en: Wagyu tendon simmered until it collapses, with aubergine that has drunk up the braise
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦「該当なし」（店のグルテンフリー醤油で煮る）。Chart flags beef only; braised in the house gluten-free soy.

items.ja: 生雲丹乗せ胡麻豆腐 旨出汁かけ
items.en: Silky sesame tofu topped with raw sea urchin under a gentle sweet dashi, scented with shiso
items.note: アレルゲン表：乳あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags dairy (English sheet) but no wheat. Uni and dashi.

items.ja: 香味野菜と蒸し鶏のサラダ
items.en: Aromatic herbs and moist steamed chicken in a light house dressing
items.note: アレルゲン表：鶏のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags chicken only — the dressing is wheat-free, which shop dressings usually are not.

items.ja: 大山鶏手羽一夜干し唐揚げ
items.en: Daisen chicken wings dried overnight in bone broth then fried until the skin shatters; Rokusuke salt and yuzu-kosho on the side
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」（衣に小麦粉を使わず、フライヤーも米粉専用）。Karaage is normally wheat-dusted and fried in a shared wheat fryer; here the chart clears both wheat and barley. The salt is flagged 魚介.

items.ja: 里芋のスパイシーフライ
items.en: Whole taro deep-fried until crisp outside and sticky inside, Cajun-spiced and salted
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦「該当なし」、魚介（ろく助の塩）あり。Chart clears wheat and barley; the Rokusuke salt carries a fish flag, so ask before calling it vegan.

items.ja: 米粉の天麩羅盛り合わせ
items.en: Rice-flour tempura assortment — startlingly light
items.note: 衣は米粉。アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦「該当なし」。Rice-flour batter, dedicated fryer; chart flags prawn, egg and fish but not wheat.

items.en: Prawn tempura, two pieces, in the rice-flour batter
items.note: アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.ja: 野菜の天麩羅盛り合わせ
items.en: Vegetable tempura assortment
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（天麩羅粉）・魚介（塩）あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat but flags egg in the batter, so vegetable does not mean vegan here.

items.en: Spicy pollock roe seared on the outside, still raw in the middle
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Mentaiko cure normally contains soy sauce; the chart here shows no wheat.

items.en: Shuto — bonito innards salted and aged for months into a dense, briny paste. A Kochi delicacy, eaten in tiny amounts with sake
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（鰹酒盗）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags fish only.

items.en: Lightly pickled seasonal vegetables — the palate cleanser between dishes
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし — no soy-sauce brine, no dashi.

items.ja: 和牛ミスジしゃぶしゃぶ（野菜付き）
items.en: Misuji (top blade) wagyu swished through a salt broth built on the shop's soba dashi, with vegetables and house ponzu. Finish it with 〆の十割蕎麦 or 〆の更科蕎麦 at ¥715
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。スープもポン酢も店のグルテンフリー仕様。Chart flags beef only; the broth and the ponzu are both the house wheat-free versions.

items.ja: 特上牛タンしゃぶしゃぶ（野菜付き）
items.en: Thin-sliced premium beef tongue through the same soba-dashi salt broth — a texture you do not get from grilled tongue
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags beef only.

items.en: Duck breast cooked low and slow, then finished over charcoal in the house yakitori tare
items.note: アレルゲン表：鴨・魚介（塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。自家製焼き鳥のタレもグルテンフリー。Yakitori tare is soy-and-mirin everywhere else; the chart shows this house version carries no wheat.

items.ja: 大山鶏もも肉醤油麹焼き
items.en: Chicken thigh marinated in shoyu-koji and grilled yuan-style — the soba shop's version of yakitori
items.note: アレルゲン表：鶏のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Shoyu-koji is normally wheat-fermented; the chart clears this one.

items.en: Wagyu sirloin with salt, real wasabi and a house onion sauce
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛・魚介（塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.ja: 神戸牛溶岩焼きステーキ
items.en: Kobe beef cooked to your liking on a searing lava stone at the table
items.note: アレルゲン表に未掲載。Not on the published allergen chart (it is a newer addition). The kitchen is wheat-flour-free but confirm the sauce before ordering.

items.ja: 神戸牛・まぐろ・サーモン 手巻き寿司セット
items.en: Roll-your-own hand-roll set with Kobe beef, tuna and salmon
items.note: アレルゲン表に未掲載。付属の醤油の種類を要確認。Not on the published chart; the tuna hand-roll elsewhere on this menu contains wheat via smoked soy, so ask which soy comes with the set.

items.ja: 車海老の味噌漬け焼き
items.en: Tiger prawn marinated in miso and grilled crisp — shell, head and all, eaten whole
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」（麦味噌ではない）。Chart clears barley, i.e. the marinade is not 麦味噌.

items.en: Aged Awaji onion — sweet, soft, almost no bite — grilled and salted
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（ろく助の塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Only the salt carries a fish flag — ask about it for vegan.

items.en: Aged Beniharuka sweet potato cooked slowly to candy sweetness, topped with a soy-derived 'butter'
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。バターは大豆由来と店が明記。Chart shows nothing flagged and the shop states the butter is 大豆由来 (soy-derived) — so it is plant-based despite the name.

items.en: Lotus root griddled with the house gluten-free soy — still crunchy
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーの醤油で香ばしく」と明記、アレルゲン表も14品目「該当なし」。Shop states the gluten-free soy by name and the chart flags nothing.

items.ja: 本鮪の手巻き（やま幸鮪の手巻き）
items.en: Hand-roll of raw Yamayuki bluefin with freshly grated wasabi, in smoked-nori vinegar rice
items.note: 店が商品説明に「※グルテンが入っています」と明記、アレルゲン表も燻製醤油による小麦を表示。The shop itself prints 'contains gluten' on this one item and the chart confirms wheat via the 燻製醤油 (smoked soy). The single deliberate exception on an otherwise wheat-free menu — do not assume, read the line.

items.en: Roughly chopped Yamayuki chutoro with takuan pickle in a hand-roll — the item the shop's Instagram is built on
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ（海苔に海老・蟹コンタミ表示）、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat — unlike the tuna hand-roll directly above it, which does not. Read carefully.

items.en: One-bite sushi pairing Ozaki beef with raw sea urchin
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介・牛のみ、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.en: Toyosu-market raw sea urchin heaped into a hand-roll
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.en: Wrapped in front of you: mochi and kibi-sugar bean paste from Nishi-Ogikubo's Echigo Tsuruya, around a seasonal fruit
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし — so no wheat starch in the mochi, which is not a given. Ask whether the anko uses dairy before calling it vegan.

items.en: Kneaded to order from real warabi and lotus starch, with house Okinawan brown-sugar syrup and kinako
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。本わらび粉・蓮粉・黒糖・きな粉のみ。Chart flags nothing; ingredients are bracken starch, lotus starch, black sugar and soy flour. Most cheap warabimochi is potato-starch-and-wheat — this one is not.

items.en: Yame matcha from Fukuoka whisked at your table and poured over thick matcha ice cream
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：胡桃（ヌガー）・乳（アイス）あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart flags walnut in the nougat and dairy in the ice cream but no wheat. Not vegan.

items.ja: 本日の土鍋ご飯 炊き込みご飯（きのこ）
items.romaji: honjitsu no donabe gohan — takikomi gohan (kinoko)
items.en: A rice-bowl portion of the day's clay-pot rice — mushrooms cooked into the rice with aged bonito dashi. Add 漬物 pickles +¥330 or salmon and smoked daikon +¥880
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（鰹出汁）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。自家製のタレもグルテンフリー。Chart flags fish stock only; the seasoning tare is the house gluten-free soy.

items.en: Eight courses: roast sobagaki, the five-piece sobamae platter, seared Ozaki beef tartare, the day's sashimi, kitsune-yaki, miso-grilled tiger prawn, shoyu-koji chicken, then your choice of sarashina or juwari soba, finishing with matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,600／飲み放題付き ¥8,000
items.note: コース中の蕎麦前盛り合わせのみアレルゲン表で大麦（山ウニ）「入っている」。他の構成品は小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Every course dish is cleared of wheat and barley by the shop's chart EXCEPT the sobamae platter, which carries barley via 山ウニ — ask them to substitute it. Two guests minimum, two-hour seating, 75-minute drink package.

items.ja: 特上牛タンしゃぶしゃぶコース
items.en: Six courses building to beef-tongue shabu-shabu, with the finishing soba and matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,000／飲み放題付き ¥7,500
items.note: 同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。Same barley caveat on the included sobamae platter — ask for a substitution; everything else is chart-clear.

items.ja: 和牛ミスジしゃぶしゃぶコース
items.en: Six courses building to misuji wagyu shabu-shabu, with the finishing soba and matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,600／飲み放題付き ¥8,000
items.note: 同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。Same barley caveat on the included sobamae platter.
